title: The manifest names required payloads
notes: 2 minutes / explanation. Teaching intent: The manifest names required payloads. Define: Hash input, protocol, configuration and source; exclude the manifest from hashing itself. Walk through: A file cannot generally include its own final hash. Keep the required payload hashes in a separate manifest. Ask: Does a matching unsigned manifest authenticate a sender? Expected answer and boundary: No. Someone can replace both payload and digest. Trust needs an external reference or signature. Visual purpose: show Required file set > Per-file digest > Manifest > Compare. Facilitation: ask students for a prediction before execution, locate the actual intermediate values, and distinguish observation from interpretation.
